about: Every key the mashup reads. Keys are GLFW names. 'vanilla:' keys reuse the player's Minecraft binding. Generates ControlDefs.java.

rows.label: Gear wheel (hold)
rows.action: Hold to open the Riders Republic gear wheel, release on a sport to switch. A quick tap still selects hotbar slot 1.

rows.label: Style trick
rows.action: Combine with a direction for bike style tricks, snow tweaks and wingsuit rolls

rows.label: Pedal / rocket boost
rows.action: Pedal harder on bikes, fire the rocket on the rocket wingsuit

rows.label: Deploy wingsuit
rows.action: Press in the air with a wingsuit equipped to start gliding
